caseInstanceId.description: The Case Management case instance ID for this property claim. Passed as the caseInstanceId parameter to the Get Case Plan and Get Case Rules tools.

folderKey.description: The Orchestrator folder key where the case plan and rules workflows are deployed. Passed directly to both tools. This is a deployment-time constant for the solution folder.

caseCurrentExecutionState.description: Engine snapshot for this invocation. Contains: event (type + parameters, isExternal), state.tasksRunning (with name + identifier), state.tasksCompleted, state.stagesEntered, state.stagesExited, state.stagesCompleted, state.vars (the case variables, e.g. claimReference, injuryTypeCode, liabilityBasisCode, fraudScore, liabilityOutcome, hiddenDamageFound, estimatedCost).

caseRulesDecisions.description: The decision produced by the deterministic rules layer for this event. May be empty when no rule matched.

eventId.description: Optional. Set only when the invocation was triggered by an external event whose richer payload is stored separately and must be fetched via an attached tool.

caseManagerDecisions.description: All orchestration actions the agent has decided to take for this invocation.

tasksToRun.description: Tasks the agent wants to start. Each entry must use the canonical taskName from the Case Plan.

taskName.description: Canonical task name copied verbatim from the Case Plan returned by Get Case Plan, including any trailing spaces.

triggeringDecision.description: Non-empty explanation of the signal or reasoning that drove this task being started.

tasksToCancel.description: Tasks the agent wants to cancel. Each entry must use the running task identifier from the execution state, not the task name.

identifier.description: Running task identifier from caseCurrentExecutionState.state.tasksRunning — not the task name.

triggeringDecision.description: Non-empty explanation of why this running task is being cancelled.

stagesEntered.description: Stages the agent wants to enter. Each entry must use the canonical stageName from the Case Plan.

stageName.description: Canonical stage name copied verbatim from the Case Plan returned by Get Case Plan, including any trailing spaces.

triggeringDecision.description: Non-empty explanation of the signal that drove this stage transition.

stagesExited.description: Stages the agent wants to exit without completing — an early exit or rework path — for example when an event invalidates the stage's premise.

stageName.description: Canonical stage name copied verbatim from the Case Plan returned by Get Case Plan, including any trailing spaces.

triggeringDecision.description: Non-empty explanation of why this stage is being exited without completing.

stagesCompleted.description: Stages the agent judges complete because all required tasks have finished.

stageName.description: Canonical stage name copied verbatim from the Case Plan returned by Get Case Plan, including any trailing spaces.

triggeringDecision.description: Non-empty explanation of why this stage is judged complete.

traces.description: Escalation messages and reasoning traces. Populated when the agent cannot fully resolve a decision, encounters contradictory signals, or must escalate a decision reserved for a person rather than decide it.

message.description: Escalation message or reasoning trace explaining the unresolved signal or the decision being handed to a person.
